recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: half a million galaxies captured in one cosmic survey frame
ancient philosophers quoted across the morning feed
AI tutors helping strangers hold new words in memory
San Francisco summer holding at fifteen degrees under broken cloud
August daylight stretching past eight in the evening

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Survey a drifting star field by dragging a telescope reticle to collect galaxy clusters before they redshift out of frame.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each 30-second pass fills another slice of the cosmic mosaic.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Field rotation speeds up; dim galaxies appear among bright decoys.

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Words rain down from a philosopher's lexicon — flick each term into virtue, knowledge, or happiness columns before it dissolves.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Clearing a triplet unlocks a quote fragment at the bottom of the screen.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Homonyms and near-synonyms blur category lines mid-round.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: marble bust silhouettes on warm parchment

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one continuous path through rolling summer fog banks to link hilltop nodes before the marine layer swallows them.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Linking all nodes in a single unbroken stroke clears the sky.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Fog thickens mid-draw, erasing trail segments behind you.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Tap launch pulses timed to a sunrise countdown — each beat spawns a tiny agent that completes one micro-task on a floating phone screen.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Syncing the final beat to sunrise completion is the round's payoff.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Polyrhythm layers stack as shortcuts multiply on screen.
